title: The wall that settled it
sub: Where · when · what was at stake, in one line. Example: Bedroom wall, rented flat — documented on move-in day, re-measured at move-out.

photos.alt: Describe the photo for screen readers. Example: Long vertical crack with a coin taped beside it for scale.
photos.caption: Figure 1 — the captured photo, with the coin for scale.

quote.text: What you (or the tenant) said, in one or two sentences.

method: One line on how it was measured. Example: Photo + coin for scale, measured in SnapClaim; tilt corrected from the coin's ellipse.
verification: One line on the checks. Example: Evidence gate passed; independent skeptic verified; mask cross-check verified.
outcome: What happened because of the report. Example: The landlord accepted the numbers and the deposit was returned in full.
